Cascara Sagrada.



Rhamnus Purshiana. (California.) N. O. Rhamnaceæ. Extract of bark.



Clinical. ─   Constipation. Rheumatism.



Characteristics. ─   I mention this well-known
        purgative because it has been found empirically curative in cases of subacute and chronic
        rheumatism with constipation. Pathogenetic effects on patients taking it for constipation
        have been recorded: Vomiting, severe griping, hæmorrhage; in one case temporary insanity
        (from a home-made decoction of the bark). In two cases choleraic symptoms were produced.
        Only material doses have been used.
